# THE PROPHET BOUND — the ceiling of ANY arrival-time model.  The rule is strictly causal in STRUCTURE (it never sees a future arrival, it commits at the arrival second, it loses the phase when it seats) and is granted exactly one hindsight privilege: the TRUE certificate of the candidate in front of it.

# HINDSIGHT — not deployable, not fitted, never a promotion target.  It exists to split the deficit in two: PROPHET - ZOO is the PREDICTION gap (a modelling target), DP - PROPHET is the STRUCTURE gap (the intrinsic price of deciding at arrival, which no model can recover and only a contract change could).
